description: charter's Renovate preset: a repo's renovate.json (written by charter repo) extends it at the release it pins. Not the workflows: charter writes those. A new release of a pinned repo opens a pull request; minor and patch ones merge themselves once its checks pass. https://joeblew999.github.io/charter/guides/repos.html

customManagers.description: Task folders a mise.toml includes from GitHub: [task_config] includes = ["git::https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git//<folder>?ref=vX.Y.Z"]

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates merge themselves when the checks pass; a major one waits for a person
charter's tool, task folders and Go library move together: one pull request
